code:
Vague:  "a fact table about orders"
Grain:  "one row per (order_id, line_item_id) —
         an order with 3 items produces 3 rows"
caption: Getting the grain wrong later is a redesign, not a tweak.

code:
Star:      DimProduct (redundant, but one join)
Snowflake: DimProduct + DimCategory (less redundant,
           but every query now pays an extra join)
caption: Star's redundancy usually wins for analytics read performance.

code:
MERGE INTO DimCustomer AS target
USING CustomerUpdates AS source
ON target.customer_id = source.customer_id
   AND target.is_current = 1
WHEN MATCHED AND target.email <> source.email THEN
  UPDATE SET target.end_date = current_date(),
             target.is_current = 0
caption: A targeted merge into a Delta table, not a full table rewrite.
